meta.title: Stitch grid demo
meta.notes: A tiny sampler to show the interactive .knit grid: ribbing, eyelets, and a raglan increase row with markers. Not a real garment.

blocks.source: Row 1 (RS): *K2, P2; repeat from * to end. (24 sts)
Row 3 (RS): *K2, YO, K2tog; repeat from * to end. (24 sts — YO and decrease cancel)

blocks.text: Work the rib and eyelet sequence three times total.
blocks.source: Repeat the two-row sampler sequence 3 times total.

blocks.text: Raglan increase row — 4 markers, BOR, +4 sts
blocks.source: Row 5 (RS): BOR, *knit to marker, M1R, sm, K1, sm, M1L; rep, knit to end. (+4 sts)

blocks.text: Short-row turn — DS then purl back
blocks.source: Row 6 (WS): turn, DS, P10, turn. (short row across part of the piece)

blocks.text: Long runs collapse with … (2 either side of a marker)
blocks.source: Row 7 (RS): K13, M1R, sm, K1, sm, M1L, K14. (long knit runs collapse)

blocks.text: Unknown stitches are flagged, never guessed
blocks.source: Row 8 (RS): K4, CDD, K4, SKPO, K4. (CDD/SKPO aren't in the token set → flagged red)
